notes.title: New Font Announcement
notes.content:
This patch includes a new set of font tiles, generated with a new improved version of our homegrown "Iconic Build Style Font Generator" Artificial Intelligence. Features of the new font includes:

- Better clarity
- Lowercase glyphs
- Special characters
- Scandinavian[sic] characters
- Basically whole 33-127 of CP437 + some extra

Cheerful message from Seppo has been also added into the controls info screen.

Skilander Product Team will now recede into spring break (if major bugs don't surface), and then we shall see what our Mapster32 Worldbuilding Experts have came up with!
